eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 41 · Grouping and Aggregating

eyebrow: ROLLUP only rolls up one direction
code:
-- ROLLUP (Color, Size): detail, Color subtotals, grand total
-- No "Size alone" subtotal row exists in this result
caption: That combination falls outside the hierarchy ROLLUP assumes.

code:
SELECT Color, Size, SUM(ListPrice) AS TotalListPrice,
       COUNT(*) AS ProductCount
FROM Production.Product
GROUP BY CUBE (Color, Size);
caption: Adds the Size-alone subtotal too — the full power set.

eyebrow: Which one do you reach for?

steps.label: ROLLUP
steps.sub: A real hierarchy — year, quarter, month

eyebrow: GROUPING_ID(): one number instead of several
code:
SELECT Color, Size, SUM(ListPrice) AS TotalListPrice,
       GROUPING_ID(Color, Size) AS SubtotalLevel
FROM Production.Product
GROUP BY CUBE (Color, Size)
ORDER BY GROUPING_ID(Color, Size);
caption: 0 = detail row. Higher numbers = each kind of subtotal.

subtitle: Putting ROLLUP and CUBE to work.
